column16: Availability

Healthy; full participant, says he's healthy to begin camp

Upper-body injury; returned to team practice September 23; possible preseason return Saturday. Retain two-game estimate pending clearance.
Left September 26 preseason game for precautionary reasons. No confirmed regular-season absence; verify clearance before the opener. No additional missed-games deduction.
Left shoulder surgery (injured Jul 2), ~4 months; skating solo, no contact; projected early-November return
Late-June shoulder surgery (labrum + rotator cuff), 4-6 month timeline; back on ice Sep 17, ahead of schedule, expected back in October but not for opener
Healthy; participating in camp, no current injury reported
Injured non-roster status reported Sep 28; no standard IR waiting period for activation. Opener availability remains unconfirmed. Four missed games is an estimate, not a return date.

Not injured: unsigned RFA (CBJ), absent from camp; GM Waddell reported progress Sep 22, expects deal; small risk of missing early games

Day-to-day for personal reasons (birth of first child), not injury; healthy
IR; follow-up procedure on Olympic left-leg fracture (announced Sep 10); GM's best-case target Nov 1, no guarantees

Healthy; TRADED COL->CBJ on Jun 25, 2026; on CBJ camp roster, expected PP/PK role
Healthy; broken finger from March healed, at camp
Unsigned RFA (DET) but attending camp and practicing; talks ongoing

Healthy; skating on COL top power-play unit Sep 22

Minor shoulder injury from captain's skate; expected healthy for Sep 30 opener at COL
Summer adductor surgery; out 4-5 weeks from Sep 16 (mid/late-Oct return); skating in full gear Sep 21
Sports hernia surgery; expected to miss start of season, possibly ~2 weeks in

Unsigned RFA (CAR), not attending camp; trade talk reported
Healthy (EDM); no current injury, focused on conditioning

ACL recovery; possible Friday preseason return. Estimate unchanged.
